note: The base unit's studies in a row beside the tree (scripts/unit_studies.py): meshes in cells of the lattice as homage.json's (v x1000, w x255, t), each with the eye it closes for; the sphere as blocks.

studies.name: The ladder of levels
studies.said: Each figure holds three of itself one size down at its corners and one upside down, four sizes down, in its hole: lengths of 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 thirds of a block, then 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, then 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, each the sum of the two before. From this stone it is one drawing; walk round it and its levels fan apart.

studies.name: The crux
studies.said: The circles that hold the figure at three sizes, its outline 8, 13 and 21 thirds of a block across, all touch at one point, the corner the drawing never draws: the crux. From this stone the three figures meet there too; step off and they come apart.

studies.name: The closed curve
studies.said: Nine bars, each bent back a third of the way along your line of sight, in the third of its length that nothing else in the drawing covers, on arcs of stated circles: it closes for real. From here it is the drawing; from anywhere else, a zigzag.

studies.name: The sphere of the unit
studies.said: Every block whose middle lies within three of its middle: 136 of them, in six layers of 12, 24, 32, 32, 24 and 12. It never becomes the perfect sphere, which is his head alone; the pearl he throws is this same sphere, built small.
